body: Most people borrow money at some point in their lives, usually for something big like a home or a car.
大多数人一生中都会借钱，通常是为了买房、买车这类大件。
But as living costs rise, more people are borrowing just to pay bills or buy food, and that changes everything.
但随着生活成本上升，越来越多人借钱只是为了付账单和买吃的，性质就完全变了。
Debt is not only about numbers. It follows you home at night, and talking about it openly is often the first step out.
债务不只是数字问题。它会跟着你回家、在夜里压着你，而愿意开口谈它，往往是走出来的第一步。
City life comes with a constant background noise: traffic, building work, and thousands of voices passing by.
城市生活自带一层持续的背景噪音：车流、施工，还有身边成千上万的人声。
Research suggests that long exposure to loud noise can raise our anxiety levels, even when we stop noticing it.
研究显示，长期暴露在噪音里会推高焦虑水平，哪怕我们早已对它习以为常。
Some cities are fighting back with quiet gardens, softer road surfaces and small green corners where people can simply breathe.
一些城市正在反击：修建静音花园、铺设更柔软的路面，留出小片绿色角落，让人能好好喘口气。

articles.zh: 阅读如何重塑你的大脑
body: Humans were never born to read. Unlike speaking, reading is a skill our brains had to invent from scratch.
人类天生并不会阅读。和说话不同，阅读是大脑必须从零发明出来的一项技能。
Learning to read rewires parts of the brain, connecting vision and language in a way that non-readers do not develop.
学会阅读会重新连接大脑的某些区域，把视觉和语言接在一起，而不识字的人不会形成这种连接。
That is good news for adult learners: your brain keeps changing, so it is never too late to pick up a new language.
这对成年学习者是好消息：大脑一直在变，所以任何时候开始学一门新语言都不算晚。
tips: 重新接线、重塑（神经连接）

articles.en: Searching for Life on Another Planet
body: For centuries people have looked at the night sky and asked the same question: is anybody else out there?
几个世纪以来，人们仰望夜空，问的都是同一个问题：那边还有别人吗？
Today scientists no longer look for spaceships. They look for tiny chemical clues in the air of distant planets.
今天的科学家不再找飞船了，他们在遥远行星的大气里寻找极其微小的化学线索。
Even a hint of the right gas would be huge news, though researchers warn that one clue alone proves nothing.
哪怕只测到一点点特定气体，都会是天大的新闻——但研究者提醒，单一线索什么也证明不了。
tips: 在外面、在远方（此处指宇宙中）

articles.zh: 超加工食品到底该不该吃
body: Ultra-processed food is everywhere: instant noodles, packaged bread, fizzy drinks and most things in a colourful wrapper.
超加工食品无处不在：泡面、包装面包、汽水，还有大多数装在花花绿绿包装里的东西。
It is cheap, convenient and designed to taste good, which is exactly why it is so hard to eat less of it.
它便宜、方便，而且被专门设计得很好吃——这正是我们很难少吃的原因。
Experts are still arguing about the science, but most agree on one simple rule: cook at home when you can.
专家们对其中的科学仍有争论，但大多数人认同一条朴素的规则：能自己在家做饭就自己做。
